name: SLB1
relation_to_history: INDEPENDENT_ILLUSTRATIVE_BENCHMARK: not the Q4E5/Q4E14/Q4F simulator; numbers are not comparable to historical qualification measurements.
terminal_regret: mean over the 16 queries of max(max_a p(a|x'), stop_payoff) - U(decision); U(expert a) = p(a|x'), U(STOP) = stop_payoff; expected (clean) utilities, not sampled outcomes
online_regret: mean over acquisition steps of max_a p_t(a) - p_t(a_t); expected (clean) utilities
acquisition_cost: No explicit per-observation cost in any contract. Each contract reports terminal regret, online regret, expert queries and feedback reads separately; no conversion to a single net utility is made.
potential_outcomes: C[e,t,a] = 1[Ur[e,t,a] < p[e,t,a]] (clean event); Y[e,t,a,r] = C[e,t,a] XOR F[e,t,a,r] (reading r of that event). A policy that selects a_t receives Y[e,t,a_t,0..R-1] only.
seed_derivation: uint64 key = first 8 bytes (little endian) of SHA-256('elpis/cgc_lao/solver_lab/v1/' + '/'.join(labels)); element i of a stream = splitmix64 finalizer of key + (i+1)*0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 (mod 2^64), top 53 bits / 2^53

TRAIN.use: fitting baseline coefficients (CGC weights, SGD rate, BETA strength) and gate scales

DEV.use: research loop; each round uses fresh seeds

VALIDATION.use: confirmation of the selected candidates before freezing

HOLDOUT.use: opened once for the frozen candidates

ci_method: two-sided 95% Student-t interval of the per-router-seed paired mean difference (n_seeds - 1 degrees of freedom)
